description: This bar chart illustrates a comparison of runtime performance for different models in a streaming environment. The horizontal axis displays the model categories: “Our joint framework”, “ChatGPT”, “DeepSeek”, “LLaMA”, and “Claude”, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Runtime (seconds)”, represents the runtime values, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, incrementing by 50.  There are five individual bars, each representing a model’s runtime. The “Our joint framework” bar is green and extends to a value of 77 seconds. The “ChatGPT” bar is light blue and reaches 190 seconds. The “DeepSeek” bar is a darker blue and extends to 365 seconds. The “LLaMA” bar is light blue and reaches 172 seconds. Finally, the “Claude” bar is a darker blue and extends to 243 seconds. The bars are not visually emphasized with any shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
